unit: WF4 Approval Gate fails closed when the referenced approval id is not on the register
description: A decision that names an approval_id with no matching row in Load Approvals must return gate INVALID and must never reach the delivery-identity block, so no send_key, dry_key or communication_id is emitted for it.
why_it_exists: Gate check step 2 of wf4/approval-gate.js is the first fail-closed test after the owner gate: no approval row, no decision. The delivery-key families only test rows that DO exist, so a decision naming an absent approval id was unasserted. This pins that the gate refuses a missing approval rather than defaulting to a send, and that Config keys downstream nodes read survive the refusal untouched.

drafts.content: Our client requires the vehicle inspection report referred to in your letter of 14 January.

expect.note: The register row for a DIFFERENT approval id exists; the referenced id does not. A missing approval must fail closed, not fall through to a send.

assertions: a decision naming an approval_id with no register row returns gate INVALID
the refusal names the missing approval as the reason, so Log Gate Refusal and Telegram - Gate Refused carry it
dry_run is normalised to the boolean true and passed through on the refusal
Config keys the downstream nodes read (matter_id, approval_id, route_group) survive the refusal untouched
no delivery identity or recipient is emitted on a path that refused before the derivation block
